source.quote: Removed the function `Stripe.constructEventWithoutVerification()` that was mistakenly added in version 22.5.0 of this package.

tasks.reasoning:
The repo uses stripe-node 13.11.0 pinned to API version 2023-08-16. The 2026 SDK majors (19–23) and the Dahlia/Endive API versions are reached through one move: upgrade stripe-node to 23 and set apiVersion to 2026-09-30.endive. Within that move, the concrete break is checkout.sessions.create sending payment_method_types, which endive rejects. Indirect break: the jump passes 2025-03-31.basil, which removed Subscription.current_period_end in favor of item-level periods. The webhook and lib/stripe.ts code that computes stripeCurrentPeriodEnd from retrieved subscriptions likely reads it and must be checked. The migration agent should also check that the client is created with `new Stripe(...)` (22.0.0) and fix TypeScript type changes. It should align the webhook endpoint's API version in the Stripe dashboard with the new SDK version so constructEvent payloads match the types. Nothing breaks today, because the old pin keeps working, but the repo is many majors behind. The breaks only appear when bumping.
This task also resolves these changes. Handle each in the same change, and say in the PR how:
- stripe:2026-09-30-endive-api-version (api-version): New API major 2026-09-30.endive carries breaking changes; pin it via Stripe-Version or upgrade SDKs (node 23, python 16, go v87), effective 2026-09-30. stripe-node 23 pins 2026-09-30.endive. Moving the apiVersion in src/lib/stripe.ts to endive is part of this same upgrade.
  Source: https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/endive.md
  "As the first version in the Endive release, `2026-09-30.endive` introduces both breaking changes and new features."
- stripe:2026-03-25-dahlia-api-version (api-version): API major 2026-03-25.dahlia with breaking changes (Checkout ui_mode enum values, events_from on event destinations, Capabilities risk requirements, Stripe.js method removals), effective 2026-03-25. Endive includes all Dahlia breaking changes. Jumping from 2023-08-16 to endive in this PR absorbs the Dahlia move; there is no separate step.
  Source: https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/dahlia.md
  "As the first version in the Dahlia release, `2026-03-25.dahlia` introduces both breaking changes and new features"
- stripe:2026-09-30-remove-payment-method-types-checkout (field-removed): payment_method_types removed from Checkout Sessions create, and paymentMethodTypes option removed from Elements deferred intents (Stripe.js), effective 2026-09-30. checkout.sessions.create in src/trpc/index.ts:73 passes payment_method_types. That only fails once the API version is endive, so dropping the parameter (or relying on dynamic payment methods) belongs in this upgrade.
  Source: https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/endive.md
  "We [removed the `payment_method_types` parameter from Checkout Sessions]"
- stripe:node-22-0-0 (sdk-major): stripe-node (npm) 22.0.0: Stripe is a true ES6 class (use new Stripe()), types reworked, per-request host override removed, effective 2026-04-02. This is an intermediate stripe-node major crossed when moving from 13.11.0 to 23. Stripe must be constructed with `new Stripe()`, and the types were reworked.
  Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/stripe-node/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md
  "Stripe import is now a true ES6 class. Use `new Stripe()` to create a StripeClient instead of calling it:"
- stripe:node-21-0-0 (sdk-major): stripe-node (npm) 21.0.0: pins 2026-03-25.dahlia, drops Node 16, decimal_string fields become Stripe.Decimal, wrong webhook parsing method throws, effective 2026-03-25. This is an intermediate major crossed in the same upgrade. It pins dahlia, decimal_string fields become Stripe.Decimal, and the wrong webhook parsing method now throws; the repo uses constructEvent, which is correct.
  Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/stripe-node/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md
  "All `decimal_string` fields changed type from `string` to `Stripe.Decimal` in both request params and response objects."
- stripe:node-20-0-0 (sdk-major): stripe-node (npm) 20.0.0: pins 2025-11-17.clover; v2 array params use indexed serialization (may break mock-server tests), effective 2025-11-18. This is an intermediate major crossed in the same upgrade. It changes v2 array serialization; the repo has no v2 calls.
  Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/stripe-node/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md
  "This may break any unit tests that expect the latter behavior when setting up a mock server."
- stripe:node-19-0-0 (sdk-major): stripe-node (npm) 19.0.0: pins 2025-09-30.clover; parseThinEvent renamed parseEventNotification, v2 delete returns V2DeletedObject, v2 nullable props optional; 19.x deprecated (Files API timeout bug), effective 2025-09-30. This is an intermediate major crossed in the same upgrade. parseThinEvent was renamed; the repo doesn't use it.
  Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/stripe-node/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md
  "Rename function `StripeClient.parseThinEvent` to `StripeClient.parseEventNotification` and remove the `Stripe.ThinEvent` interface."

callSites.why: The pinned apiVersion '2023-08-16' must change to '2026-09-30.endive' to match stripe-node 23's types. Also check that the client is created with `new Stripe(...)`, as required since 22.0.0.
checkout.sessions.create passes payment_method_types, which is removed on endive and would make Checkout creation fail. Remove it.
webhooks.constructEvent stays available. The event payload shape follows the webhook endpoint's API version, and the Event types change with the SDK major.

subscriptions.retrieve response shape changes across basil→endive. current_period_end moved off Subscription onto subscription items in 2025-03-31.basil; check any reads of subscription.current_period_end and items.
subscriptions.retrieve: the same Subscription response-shape check applies (current_period_end and price fields).
subscriptions.retrieve: the same Subscription response-shape check applies for the plan and period-end computation.
billingPortal.sessions.create: verify params and types still compile after the SDK major; no known break.

record.prBody:
## stripe-node (npm) 23.0.0: pins 2026-09-30.endive; removes Stripe.constructEventWithoutVerification, ErrorType export, V2List V1-only fields [Verified]

### Change

Upgraded stripe to 23.0.0 (installed with --legacy-peer-deps because of existing peer conflicts). Pinned apiVersion to 2026-09-30.endive. Removed payment_method_types from checkout.sessions.create. The webhook now reads the period end from items.data[0].current_period_end. The invoice.payment_succeeded branch takes the subscription id from invoice.parent.subscription_details.subscription and returns 200 if it is absent. The Stripe client falls back to a placeholder key when STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is unset, because v23 throws on an empty key at construction and that broke next build. Added scripts/check-stripe-migration.js as a source-level check.

Files touched:
- `package-lock.json`
- `package.json`
- `scripts/check-stripe-migration.js`
- `src/app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts`
- `src/lib/stripe.ts`
- `src/trpc/index.ts`

### Why

v23 pins the endive API version. In endive, Checkout rejects payment_method_types, and since basil Subscription.current_period_end lives on the items. Invoice.subscription moved under parent.subscription_details. v22 and later throw on an empty API key.

> Removed the function `Stripe.constructEventWithoutVerification()` that was mistakenly added in version 22.5.0 of this package.

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/stripe-node/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md

### Proof

| Check | Before | After | New failures |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| typecheck | pass | pass | 0 |
| build | pass | pass | 0 |
| stripe-migration | fail (1) | pass | 0 |

New failures: 0

Checks added by the agent (they count toward proof; check that each command really tests the change):
- stripe-migration, added by the agent: `export DATABASE_URL='postgresql://user:pass@localhost:5432/db'; node scripts/check-stripe-migration.js` (fail (1) → pass)

Provider validators: none run.

Prepared before the baseline:
- Before the baseline the harness ran `npx prisma generate` (The repo's postinstall hook runs prisma generate, which was skipped. It produces the @prisma/client types that tsc and next build need.); it exited 0.
- Checks ran with placeholder env: DATABASE_URL.
- Preparation changed repo files, kept out of this PR: package-lock.json.

Test of this change: `stripe-migration`, written by the agent and run with the checks.

Where checks ran: Docker container node:22-bookworm; install scripts disabled; no host env or mounts besides the repo copy; no credentials, so no live API calls

### Unproven

- Endive response shapes were not verified against live calls.
- I did not run the provider validators (stripe_check_params and similar) on checkout.sessions.create.
- The proof test is a source-level grep script, not a runtime test.
- The existing early return on missing session.metadata.userId runs before the event branches, so invoice events (which usually carry no userId metadata) may be skipped. This predates the migration and I left it alone.
- No provider validator was run.

### Behaviour changes

- Checkout no longer restricts payment methods to card and PayPal. Stripe's dynamic payment methods now decide which ones customers see.
- A missing STRIPE_SECRET_KEY now fails at request time instead of at import time.
- The period end comes from items.data[0] only, which assumes single-item subscriptions. A missing value is stored as epoch 0.
- Align the dashboard webhook endpoint's API version to endive.
- Confirm the deploy runtime is Node >=20.

---

review.summary: The removed `constructEventWithoutVerification` is never used, so the quoted change needs no code edit. The real work is the jump from SDK 13 / API 2023-08-16 to 23 / 2026-09-30.endive. The diff handles the Basil-era moves: `current_period_end` now comes from subscription items, and the invoice's subscription is read via `parent.subscription_details`. It also makes behaviour changes the API does not force. The stripe-migration check only greps source strings and the installed version, so no webhook payload or live call was exercised. The renewal path depends on the webhook endpoint's configured API version, which nothing here verifies. 'verified' overstates what the checks prove.

concerns.issue: Stripe renders webhook payloads with the endpoint's configured API version, not the SDK's `apiVersion`. If the Dashboard endpoint is still on 2023-08-16 or any pre-Basil version, `invoice.parent` is absent, so `subscriptionId` is undefined. The handler then returns 200 silently and renewals never update `stripeCurrentPeriodEnd`. The diff turns a crash into silent data loss. Confirm or upgrade the endpoint version, and consider logging or falling back to the legacy `invoice.subscription`.

The rewritten invoice.payment_succeeded branch is still behind the existing `session?.metadata?.userId` guard (line ~27). That guard casts every event to a Checkout.Session. Invoices do not carry the checkout session's metadata, so this branch likely never runs. This is a pre-existing bug, but the new code is unreachable and untested, and the check only greps for the string.

Removing `payment_method_types: ["card","paypal"]` is a behaviour change. Checkout will now offer whatever payment methods are enabled in the Dashboard (dynamic payment methods), so PayPal may disappear or other methods may appear. I could not confirm from the quoted changelog that this parameter was removed. Check the v23 `Checkout.SessionCreateParams` types before accepting this as forced.

`(items.data[0]?.current_period_end ?? 0) * 1000` writes a 1970 date if the item is missing. `getUserSubscriptionPlan` would then mark a paying user as unsubscribed. Prefer failing loudly or skipping the update.

Changing the fallback from `?? ""` to `|| "sk_missing_key"` is an unrelated behaviour change. It hides a missing secret at construction and defers the failure to an auth error at request time. Presumably this was done to make `next build` pass.

Moving from 2023-08-16 to `2026-09-30.endive` crosses several breaking API releases, not just the one quoted. I could not confirm the `endive` version string from memory. Typecheck passing suggests it matches the SDK's pinned literal; check `ApiVersion` in node_modules/stripe types. Other fields read from API responses (`cancel_at_period_end`, `subscription.customer`) should be confirmed against that version.
stripe@23 requires Node >=20. Confirm the deployment runtime (Vercel or other) is on Node 20+.

checkFirst: Which API version is the production webhook endpoint configured with in the Stripe Dashboard? If it is pre-2025-03-31, the invoice branch silently no-ops.
Whether the `metadata.userId` guard means invoice.payment_succeeded was ever handled. If not, decide whether to fix the guard in this PR.
Whether dropping `payment_method_types` (and PayPal) is intended, and which methods are enabled in the Dashboard.
Run a test-mode checkout and renewal with `stripe trigger` / the Stripe CLI against the new SDK; the grep-based check proves none of this.
